slides.body:
Creeks, swamp scrub, grassy forest.
Every address in Victoria sits on a vegetation class that existed before the street did. Find out what grew where you live.

slides.title:
The two
of us.
slides.label: 04 / Craft, not scale
slides.alt: Natasha and Tyson, co-founders of Gardener & Son, standing on a grass path through a mature garden
slides.body: Gardener & Son is a small practice by design. We read the place, build the garden with our own hands, and keep coming back to see what it does.

slides.title:
Before the
garden,
the place.
slides.label: 01 / Start with the address
slides.body: We don't start with a look. We start with the ecology of your street — what grew here, where the water moves, what habitat remains nearby.

slides.title: A local meadow on Maylands.

slides.title:
Plant what
belongs here.
slides.label: Find My Ecological Garden
slides.body: Not a style. A species list. Your address returns the indigenous species of your vegetation class to create your own ecological garden. Ecology first, then design.
slides.caption: Species list and garden plan

slides.title: A garden isn't finished when we leave.
slides.label: 03 / After the build
slides.body: New plantings take a few seasons to settle. We can stay on through that time — watching how the garden responds and stepping in when it needs us.

slides.title: Winter crimson that answers the roof.

slides.alt: Watercolour street elevation of a garden design for a Victorian house in Hawthorn East, with a red-flowering yellow gum, banksia and understorey behind a green iron fence
slides.caption: Street elevation / Hawthorn East · In design

slides.title:
We measure
what we build.
slides.label: The Ecological Registry
slides.body: Every home built gets an energy rating. Nothing measures what's living in the garden around it. The Ecological Registry scores a garden's ecological performance and tracks it as it grows.
slides.bodyEmphasis: Nothing measures what's living in the garden around it.
slides.caption: Register · Score · Verify

slides.title:
Your garden
begins here.
slides.label: 05 / Where gardens begin
slides.body: Tell us about your place. We'll start with what's already there, what once belonged there, and what the garden could become.
